name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Hologram Flowers With Acrylic Book Vase
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality clear acrylic, offering a modern glass-like appearance while remaining lightweight and durable.
    - The vase features 3 mm-thick acrylic, precisely crafted to form a stylish book-shaped structure.
    - Available vase acrylic color choices include: transparent, green, red, and purple.
    - 3 mm-thick hologram acrylic flower available in special finishes such as Broken Glass Acrylic or Starburst Acrylic, creating a sparkling visual effect.
    - These holographic acrylic finishes provide a slightly frosted appearance compared to transparent acrylic, enhancing the decorative look.
    - Flower set options include: sets with 1 flower, 2 flowers, and 3 flowers.
    - Smooth, polished edges ensure safe handling and a refined finish.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Vase Dimensions (WxHxD): 15.2 x 20.1 x 4 cm ~ 5.98 x 7.91 x 1.57 in.
    - Flower size: 4 x 12in ~ 10.16 x 30.48cm. 
    📌 Note: 
    - The vase dimensions cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design. 
    - The flower size may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Produced using advanced UV printing technology to ensure vivid colors and sharp design details.
    - Available with single-sided or double-sided printing options.
    - The printing method provides long-lasting color quality, fade resistance, and high-definition artwork.
    - The transparent acrylic surface enhances the visual depth of the printed design.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative book-shaped acrylic vase that combines functionality with artistic display.
    - Suitable for holding decorative acrylic flowers, artificial flowers, or small dried flower arrangements.
    - Perfect for decorating bookshelves, desks, bedside tables, coffee tables, or reading spaces.
    - Adds a creative and elegant accent to living rooms, offices, libraries, or study areas.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful gift for book lovers, family members, friends, and loved ones.
    - Ideal for Mother's Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, housewarming gifts, or hobby-themed celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who enjoys unique decorative items and creative home décor.
    - Combines functional design with artistic style, making it a memorable keepsake gift.🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape 1-Layer Hologram Flowers With Acrylic Book Vase 

 

PRODUCTION

  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
